children: Bank of England policymaker Alan Taylor said holding interest rates at a restrictive level provided insurance against risks to the inflation outlook posed by events abroad, in a report published on Tuesday.

"For now, absent an extreme scenario, I judge that holding Bank Rate at a moderately restrictive level provides material and reasonable insurance against the external risks," Taylor said in a written report to parliament's Treasury Committee of lawmakers.

"But if the conflict subsides, energy prices moderate and underlying disinflation continues, the case for resuming rate cuts would become stronger," Taylor, an external member of the Monetary Policy Committee, added.
